cases.input: Synthetic Example Studio, USD, September vs approved budget. Revenue budget is 10000 units at USD 50 each (USD 500000). Actual is 11000 units at USD 48 each (USD 528000). No company materiality/always-comment threshold is supplied. Calculate total and price/volume bridge, verify the bridge, label threshold/driver status accurately.

criteria: Revenue delta is USD 28000 favorable by amount, equal to 5.6% of budget.
Volume effect is (11000-10000) × USD 50 = +USD 50000; price effect is (USD 48-USD 50) × 11000 = -USD 22000; the effects sum to +USD 28000.
Does not declare a formal materiality flag because no company threshold is supplied; states no underlying activity cause beyond given quantity/rate facts.
